corpus.text: english level: C2
german level: A1
work scope: full-time available from February, authorized to work in the example country
Built a streaming pipeline with Apache Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming for sensor data in a lab project.
Wrote ROS 2 nodes in C++ for a mobile robot; implemented SLAM with a lidar sensor and tested in simulation with Gazebo.
Designed a star-schema data warehouse in Snowflake and wrote dbt models with tests for a student startup.
Orchestrated nightly batch jobs with Apache Airflow DAGs and monitored failures with Slack alerts.
Containerized services with Docker Compose and deployed them to a small Azure virtual machine.
Trained a gradient boosting model with LightGBM to predict machine failures; tuned hyperparameters with Optuna.
Presented project results in English to an international team during a semester abroad.
